[!assets] skip 'requires embedded assets'

# A new physical store serves the browser application and empty bootstrap
# without implicitly creating a project or board.
mkdir empty-store
! exec card --store empty-store web --board missing --port 0 --no-browser
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/invalid-board.txt

exec sh probe-empty-web.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/probe.txt
cmpjson bootstrap-stable.json $WORK/golden/bootstrap.json
cmpjson catalog.json $WORK/golden/catalog.json

-- probe-empty-web.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

card --store "$PWD/empty-store" web \
  --bind 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 0 \
  --no-browser >web.out 2>web.err &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

i=0
url=
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  url=$(sed -n 's/^web application available at //p' web.out | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$url" ] && break
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done
[ -n "$url" ]

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  if curl --fail --silent --request POST \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
    --data '{}' \
    "$url/cardamom.private.v1.ProjectService/GetBootstrap" >bootstrap.json; then
    break
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done

jq 'del(.sources[].source.storeLineageId)' bootstrap.json >bootstrap-stable.json

jq '{
  projects: (.projects // []),
  boards: (.boards // []),
  serverDefaultBoardId: (.serverDefaultBoardId // null)
}' bootstrap.json >catalog.json

curl --fail --silent "$url/" >shell.body
grep '<div id="app"></div>' shell.body >/dev/null

kill -TERM "$pid"
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
echo 'empty web probe passed'

-- golden/bootstrap.json --
{"issueTypes":["ISSUE_TYPE_WORKSTREAM","ISSUE_TYPE_TASK","ISSUE_TYPE_CHECKPOINT","ISSUE_TYPE_ROUTINE"],"issueStatuses":["ISSUE_STATUS_READY","ISSUE_STATUS_BLOCKED","ISSUE_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS","ISSUE_STATUS_WAITING","ISSUE_STATUS_CLOSED","ISSUE_STATUS_CANCELLED"],"schemaVersion":"20260729090000","version":"dev","accessMode":"ACCESS_MODE_READ_WRITE","sources":[{"source":{},"health":"SOURCE_HEALTH_HEALTHY","version":"dev","schemaVersion":"20260729090000","protocol":{"version":"WEB_PROTOCOL_VERSION_V1","capabilities":["WEB_CAPABILITY_BOARD_CATALOG","WEB_CAPABILITY_BOARD_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ISSUE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_LOG_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_STATE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ATTACHMENT_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_APPROVAL_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ROUTINE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_CHANGE_READ"]}}],"protocol":{"version":"WEB_PROTOCOL_VERSION_V1","capabilities":["WEB_CAPABILITY_BOARD_CATALOG","WEB_CAPABILITY_BOARD_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ISSUE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_LOG_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_STATE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ATTACHMENT_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_APPROVAL_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_ROUTINE_READ","WEB_CAPABILITY_CHANGE_READ"]}}
-- golden/catalog.json --
{"projects":[],"boards":[],"serverDefaultBoardId":null}
-- golden/invalid-board.txt --
error: board "missing" not found
